checks.name: Source loading and module syntax
checks.detail: v13 procedural model parses and instantiates in both quality modes. v13 viewer and standalone 2D inline JavaScript both parse without syntax errors.

checks.name: Desktop procedural assembly
checks.detail: 570 mesh objects, 290 fastener instances, 11 registered engineering assemblies. Instanced matrices initialized.

checks.name: Mobile procedural assembly
checks.detail: 570 mesh objects, 290 fastener instances, 11 assemblies, 21 edge probes. No unexpected matrix gaps.

checks.name: Model-relative bucket probes
checks.detail: 21 distinct probe records: 2 points per 9 nominal tooth edges plus 3 lower sheet points. In nominal zero pose minimum clearance = +0.118 scene units.

checks.name: Nested rotation chain
checks.detail: Pose sweep uses scoop rotation, scoop-pivot translation, loader rotation, loader-pivot translation, then compares root-model Y with nominal crawler plane y=0.14.

checks.name: Swept bucket angle screen
checks.detail: 936 combinations across [-18,28] lift and [-38,38] bucket tip at 2-degree step; 493 flagged below nominal level. Worst sampled margin -0.98474 scene units at lift=28, tip=38 degrees.

checks.name: WebGL-independent SVG atlas runtime
checks.detail: Standalone 2D script executed in simulated SVG/DOM; 32 drawing elements and 580 heatmap SVG nodes created (576 cells), 303 cells flagged. Inputs changed warning text, reset restored zero pose.

checks.name: SVG exports and click controls
checks.detail: Export code and event listeners present; actual browser file-download, PDF/screenshot and SVG pixel output not tested.

checks.name: Source fidelity
checks.detail: Side shape and joint coordinates remain photo-inspired; no original measured scale, technical drawings, orthographic camera calibration or mechanical constraints.

checks.name: Real GPU WebGL viewer
checks.detail: GPU WebGL not available in this execution environment. GitHub Pages deployment only confirms publishing.

blockers: Acquire and cross-check original camera views and at least one real dimension for metric calibration.
Obtain verifiable drawing or clear source for joint axes and true bucket/workspace limits.
Run v13 WebGL page on a real desktop and mobile browser and inspect actual rendered model and atlas iframe.
Replace 2D sampled ground-reference screen with a mesh-level swept collision test only after verified geometry exists.
Keep unverified suspension alternatives and model-only limits clearly labelled.
status: v13 source-level engineering tests passed. New multi-probe bucket screen and GPU-free SVG atlas operate in code-level simulations; historical accuracy still unverified and should not be scored higher.
